rollback.sql: CREATE TABLE worker_token_denylist (jti VARCHAR(64) NOT NULL CONSTRAINT pk_worker_token_denylist PRIMARY KEY, revoked_at TIMESTAMP WITH TIME ZONE NOT NULL, expires_at TIMESTAMP WITH TIME ZONE NOT NULL); CREATE INDEX ix_worker_token_denylist_expires_at ON worker_token_denylist (expires_at);

changeSet.author: hephaestus
changeSet.comment: A review attempt still running at the upgrade to 1.0 has no lease, because 0.x never set one, so lease recovery requeues it. Counting it as a drain spends no retry for an unadmitted attempt; an admitted one is handed on to compose, as after any drain.
changeSet.sql: UPDATE review_job SET drain_count = drain_count + 1 WHERE status = 'RUNNING' AND leased_until IS NULL;
